description: Ground shaking potential relating to eastern Australian active faults: an example from the Bendigo Region with relevance to water reservoirs and tailings dams is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. We present earthquake ground motions based upon a paleoseismically-validated characteristic earthquake scenario for the ~ 48 km-long Avonmore scarp, which overlies the Meadow Valley Fault, east of Bendigo, Victoria. The results from the moment magnitude MW 7.1 scenario earthquake indicate that ground motions are sufficient to be of concern to nearby mining and water infrastructure. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Earthquake Engineering, Published_External, earthquake geology, liquefaction hazard. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
